title: The Vanishing Beauty
cast: Li Yitong, Wang Jiajia, Chang Huasen
summary: Lifestyle blogger Yu Meng sees her carefully curated life unravel on her fifth wedding anniversary. Facing betrayal and financial pressure, she turns to friends and fights to reclaim control of her future.
whyFans: The story explores the gap between a polished public image and a difficult private life.
Yu Meng's attempt to rebuild her life gives the relationship drama a personal-growth thread.
Its modern setting keeps the family, marriage and financial pressures recognisable.
review: The Vanishing Beauty gets its momentum from the collapse of a supposedly perfect life. Its most engaging angle is the protagonist's effort to make her own choices after betrayal and financial pressure. The relationship and family conflicts should give the series emotional weight, while its modern setting keeps those stakes recognisable.
